mechanics.claim: The damage and slow apply upon landing, not on cast.
mechanics.quote: Upon landing, she deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slows}} them

mechanics.claim: Scoring an enemy champion takedown or detonating Explosive Charge at max stacks on a champion resets Rocket Jump's cooldown.
mechanics.quote: Scoring an enemy {{tip|champion}} {{tip|takedown}} or detonating ''{{ai|Explosive Charge|Tristana}}'' at maximum stacks on a champion will reset ''Rocket Jump's'' {{sti|cooldown}}.

mechanics.claim: Tristana can cast any of her other abilities during the Rocket Jump dash, so it does not interrupt her damage output.
mechanics.quote: '''''Tristana''' can cast any of her [[champion ability|abilities]] during the dash.''
